locator: Ward et al., ISMRM 1998, p. 1693, Fig. 1. Isolated square above the fit near ratio 4.2 and rightmost square near 8.7.
solution: MOPS/KCl. Each Mg level was divided into aliquots for free Mg by Mag-fura-2 fluorescence and aggregate ATP Mg occupancy by calibrated phosphorus NMR.
limits: Approximate graph readings across distinct samples using the same formulation. Seven experiments at five levels are pooled. Per-marker run identity, sampling uncertainty and measured total Mg are unavailable. No fitted affinity enters this comparison.
